title: aglaia aquatica

This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties that may help to reduce inflammation, protect against cell damage, and prevent the growth of microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of Aglaia aquatica, including aglavin, aglaiol, and aglacon, are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being researched for their potential to treat various diseases.
